text:
Nous avons commandé un menu rapide qui s'est transformé en une expérience lente et décevante. Le personnel semblait totalement désintéressé, et l'attente pour un simple burger était interminable. Quand la commande est finalement arrivée, le burger était froid et assemblé n'importe comment.
​Le pire reste l'hygiène : les tables n'étaient pas nettoyées, le sol était collant, et j'ai même vu des restes de nourriture séchés on a oas eu de plateau. Honnêtement, la qualité de la nourriture et le manque de propreté sont honteux pour un établissement de cette chaîne.
​Je déconseille fortement cet endroit. Passez votre chemin. C'est trop cher pour une qualité aussi déplorable.
author: Samia

text: I've been robbed there. people saw that a woman looking like gypsy stole my camera, but even didn't dare to tell me that,  only when i found out that my bag with fotocamera disappeated. There is a band working there, they sit at tables pretendibg to be customers and look for victims and sutable moment when they are distracted. Employees told me it happenbs very often but they refused to help me, also no any warning signs about this band inside. disgusting experience in "iconic fast-foodrestaurant". PS. by the way, coffee was not good
author: Anna S

text: One of the worst McDonald's I've ever been to. The service is slow, there aren't enough people in the kitchen, and orders aren't announced, which causes confusion. The burgers are of poor quality, the coffee is very watery and undrinkable, the food at this McDonald's is not worth the money, and the presentation differs from the standard and does not match the pictures. There is even a charge for using the toilet when you order. Thanks to this McDonald's, I realised that it is not worth visiting their restaurants in Paris at all.
author: Mykyta Zelenskyi

text:
Always make sure you check your order before jumping in a cab. I've had the surprise of buying a family order of 5 burgers only to find out 20kms later that one of the bigger ones were missing.

It didn't occur to me ever for a second that I should check an employees work before leaving the fast food, especially since I was the only client at the till at that time.

Also. McDonald's France has no online complaint form, strangely you can send letters or call but you can't send an email.
author: George

text:
Expérience décevante chez McDonald’s

Même si la nourriture était chaude et correcte, la propreté laissait vraiment à désirer.
En plus, les employés semblaient mal formés et incapables de répondre à des questions simples ou de gérer les commandes correctement.

C’est dommage qu’une grande enseigne comme McDonald’s néglige des aspects aussi essentiels. Une amélioration rapide du service et de l’hygiène est nécessaire.
author: Мирна ༒

text:
Table très sale, j’ai commandé à table j’ai attendu 20min je n’ai rien reçu je vais donc au comptoir on me dit que je devais venir la chercher, répond de manière hautaine et non chalante et ne regarde pas dans les yeux ( comme si on était des chiens )
Je demande juste une pièce pour aller au toilettes car ma pièce de 50centimes n’est pas passé et on me dis « allez en haut » sur un ton exécrable.

text:
I went to this McDonald’s at 9am. Been waiting until 9:30. Meanwhile, nobody came to say anything. After 30 mins, the staff finally came to us and told us that the coffee machine didn’t work, and she couldn’t process the order even the Burgers and apples. In the end, she refunded us the payment in cash.

I mean she could have told us earlier. I wanna eat fast food, not French!!!

text: Bathrooms costs 0.50 Euros even if you buy something, ridiculous, ownership should be ashamed. Service wasn’t bad but the bathroom situation is shameful.

text: Worst McDonald’s in Paris. Staff is disorganised, lazy and you will wait ages for even simple orders. Avoid at all costs. I work in the area and this was not a simple one off experience, they have a very severe staff competence problem and it’s gotten worse. You are better off going to a sit down restaurant nearby you’ll get your food faster.
